# vpsie_certificate (Resource)

Manages a VPSie TLS certificate issued for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_certificate" "example" {
  cert_name = "my-site-cert"
  domain_id = "domain-identifier"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cert_name` (String) The name of the certificate.
- `domain_id` (String) The identifier of the domain the certificate is issued for.

### Read-Only

- `cert_type` (String) The certificate type.
- `created_on` (String) The creation timestamp of the certificate.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain name covered by the certificate.
- `identifier` (String) The unique identifier of the certificate.
- `issuer` (String) The certificate issuer.
- `serial` (String) The certificate serial number.
- `valid_from` (String) The start of the certificate validity period.
- `valid_to` (String) The end of the certificate validity period.
